items.title: Nottingham Advantage Award
items.text: The Advantage Award is the University's employability award. The aim of the Advantage Award is to ensure that students of UNNC have the opportunity to develop a range of attributes and skills and engage in activities that will enhance their overall learning experience and employability.

items.title: For the Award, you need:
items.text:
• Complete 30 credits to gain the Award; each module is 10 or 20 credits
  • Complete a maximum of 20 credits in an academic year; the marks do not count towards your overall degree result
  • ...

If you want to know more, please visit the office site.
